incident-bot: :rotating_light: URGENT: page triggered: gpu-inference-queue-growth — queue length > 5k across region-us-west-2, HPA not scaling (alert: ml-gpu-queue > 5000 for 3m)

alex: I'm on it. seeing sustained queue growth on gpu-inference-prod. requests piling in, pods at 2 replicas but CPU/GPU metrics for HPA show N/A or 0%

alex: `kubectl get hpa -n prod gpu-inference-hpa -o wide`
```
NAME                  REFERENCE                     TARGETS         MINPODS MAXPODS REPLICAS AGE
gpu-inference-hpa     Deployment/gpu-inference      <unknown>/200%   2      40      2      6h
```

james: prometheus-adapter is throwing fetch timeouts to Prometheus — seeing 504s in logs around the same time alerts started

james: logs snippet (prometheus-adapter -n monitoring):
```
E0304 02:13:42.123456 1 adapter.go:214] error fetching metric: context deadline exceeded
E0304 02:13:42.124012 1 handler.go:112] GET /apis/custom.metrics.k8s.io/v1beta1/namespaces/prod/pods/*/gpu_utilization timed out
```

rita: confirmed — Prometheus scrape for gpu-exporter on inference nodes has gaps from 02:08 -> 02:22. prometheus UI shows large ingestion delay. Probably leads adapter to return no metrics, HPA treats as 0 and refuses to scale.

alex: checking metrics-server too — `kubectl get --raw /apis/custom.metrics.k8s.io/v1beta1` returns 503 from adapter
```
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
{"kind":"Status","message":"no metrics available","status":"Failure"}
```

alex: immediate mitigation options: 1) manual scale deployment to relieve queue, 2) restart prometheus-adapter / metrics-server to restore metric flow, 3) enable temporary fallback — scale by node pool if allowed. I'm going to scale deployment to 8 replicas to buy time.

maya: I'll take the restart path (restart adapter + prometheus). Handing off after soft pause. @pagerduty-bot please escalate to platform-sre if restarts fail.

alex: executing manual scale now — `kubectl scale deploy/gpu-inference -n prod --replicas=8`

incident-bot: action — manual scale executed by alex — replicas -> 8 :white_check_mark:

alex: immediate effect: queue dropped ~30% but still high. Some customers report 429s and elevated latency. Need metrics pipeline restored for autoscale to resume normal ops.

maya: restarting prometheus-adapter and metrics-server in monitoring namespace
```
kubectl rollout restart deploy/prometheus-adapter -n monitoring
kubectl rollout restart deploy/metrics-server -n kube-system
```

maya: watching logs — adapter coming back up, showing successful queries to Prometheus now.

james: seeing adapter respond to /apis/custom.metrics.k8s.io now. HPA targets are populated: `kubectl get hpa -n prod gpu-inference-hpa -o jsonpath='{.status.currentMetrics}'` returns non-empty.

alex: HPA started scaling automatically: replicas went 8 -> 16 over 12 minutes. Queues falling, request error rate trending down.

sara: customer impact summary (preliminary): ~0.8% of inference requests received 429s during the 18m window before manual scaling; latency p95 increased from 120ms -> 900ms for affected tenants. No data loss. A small set of customers on dedicated reserved capacity saw degraded throughput when autoscale failed.

alex: marking incident mitigated — autoscale recovered, queue within normal thresholds, primary root cause looks like Prometheus ingestion/backfill lag causing adapter timeouts -> HPA metric gaps.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated — reason: prometheus-adapter failed to fetch due to Prometheus ingestion backlog. manual scaling + adapter restart restored service. Postmortem required.

maya: handoff to oncall follow-up (maya -> james) — I'll be on follow for 30m then handing to james to produce timeline and initial RCA notes.

james: will own postmortem. action items I will track:
- Collect Prometheus TSDB write/ingest metrics for the 02:00-02:30 window
- Check ingestion/backfill cause (was there a retention compaction, heavy export, or controller job?)
- Add alerting for adapter error-rate and for Prometheus scrape gap (more specific than queue)
- Add automated HPA fallback plan: if adapter returns no metrics for Xm, consider temporary scale policy / nodepool burst
- SRE runbook update: include explicit manual scale steps and handoff checklist

rita: immediate post-incident fixes I'm doing: bump scrape timeout and resync schedule for gpu-exporter to reduce chance of holes; also increasing adapter client timeout to reduce transient 504s. Will open PR.

alex: customer comms note: small set of customers impacted with elevated latency/429s; ops outreach will notify affected accounts with timeline and mitigation.

pagerduty-bot: Escalation log: page acknowledged by alex at 02:14 UTC. Severity: Sev3 -> currently mitigated.

maya: tagging follow-ups for postmortem meeting tomorrow 10:00 PT. I'll attach logs/commands. For now — leaving monitoring alerts muted for the manual scale churn window to avoid alert noise.

alex: thanks team. good catch on adapter logs, nice manual mitigation. :thumbsup:

james: summary for PM/ops: cause = Prometheus ingestion/backpressure -> adapter timeouts -> HPA metric gaps -> autoscaler stalled -> queue growth -> throttling/latency. Mitigation = manual scale + adapter restart. Next: durable fixes + runbook.

incident-bot: Closing incident thread (will open postmortem doc)."
